summary: The diff modifies frontend/src/pages/Gallery.tsx to address both requirements. REQ-2 (single static UZ quote, no Goethe, no carousel) is fully implemented. REQ-1 has the banner height set to h-[20vh] described as half of previous 40vh, satisfying the 50% reduction. However, the quote section has been moved outside the hero banner section into a separate section below it, whereas the original requirement specifies the quote should be inside the hero banner.
